description.en: Let Amadeus handle repetitive tasks in Windows apps: web searches, text editing and saving, and folder navigation. GUI Runtime clicks and types using screenshots, checks results, and can return uncertain steps to Amadeus for review. This extension connects Amadeus to Runtime; install and start Runtime separately and configure model APIs. No local GPU needed. Screenshots and task information go to your chosen model services; API fees may apply.
description.zh-CN: 让 Amadeus 帮你完成 Windows 软件中的重复操作：网页搜索、文本编辑与保存、文件夹导航。GUI Runtime 根据截图点击和输入、检查结果；遇到无法确认的步骤，可交回 Amadeus 审核。本扩展负责连接 Amadeus 与 Runtime；使用前需单独安装并启动 Runtime、配置模型 API。无需本地 GPU；截图和任务信息会发送给你选择的模型服务，API 可能收费。

runtime_url.title: Trusted loopback MCP URL / 可信本机 MCP 地址
